{{Quote|Finally, by dissecting one of the knobby spiders, our arachnid specialist discovered that the creature's body core was made primarily of calcified wood, the same as the trees. The knobby spiders ''are'' part of gnarltrees' life cycle!|[[Halka Four-Den/Legends|Halka Four-Den]] speaks about a knobby white spider on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]|<ref name="TISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>}}
The '''Knobby white spider''' was a large [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]-sized<ref name="TISWU" /> arachnid-like immature spore form of the [[Gnarltree/Legends|gnarltree]] native to the swamp [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].<ref name="TWoSW:AFG" /> In addition to the very large ones, there were also some smaller, knee-height ones; [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] ended up facing a number of these in his training.<ref name="RS III">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|I don't think I'll ever look at one of these trees in quite the same way again.|Anakin Solo, upon seeing a knobby white spider's transformation|<ref name="Anakin's Quest">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Anakin's Quest]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Knobby_White_Spider_BTS.png|thumb|250px|left|A knobby white spider in the swamps of Dagobah]]
One of the most bizarre organisms on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], the knobby white spider was in fact a mobile root that was part of the [[Gnarltree/Legends|gnarltree's]] life cycle,<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> that developed in bud colonies on their roots.<ref name="TWoSW:AFG" /> Composed primarily of calcified [[Wood/Legends|wood]],<ref name="TISWU" /> during the period of active adolescence<ref name="TWoSW:AFG" /> it would break free of its parent tree to roam the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] and devour animals<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> for five to seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="TotG" /> During this period it was vulnerable to [[Bogwing/Legends|bogwings]], [[Jubba bird/Legends|jubba birds]],<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> and others.<ref name="TWoSW:AFG" /> After gathering enough nutrients,<ref name="TISWU" /> the spider would find a clear spot to anchor its legs, and if it survived that period, eventually it would be gradually enveloped by chrysalis-like bark<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> and its legs would transform into roots<ref name="TISWU" /> that allow the spider to grow into a towering tree<ref name="ItWoSWT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> within three [[Standard month/Legends|months]].<ref name="TotG" />

The spiders had a large, lumpy body with a bloated, bulbous head, eight gnarled legs,<ref name="TISWU" /> and eight eyes that could see in all directions at once.<ref name="TotG" /> They had one large stinger on the underbelly used to capture and sedate its prey,<ref name="Anakin's Quest" /> and smaller stingers near the end of each leg to immobilize the target.<ref name="TotG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RMQ-KnobbyWhiteSpider.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ralph McQuarrie's illustration of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] facing a knobby white spider.]]
The knobby white spiders first appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the [[1995]] novel [[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']], written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]],<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref> and were first pictured in the 1995 reference book ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]'', written by Kevin J. Anderson and illustrated by [[Ralph McQuarrie]].<ref name="TISWU" /> The artwork was based on a sketch made in [[February]] [[1979]] for the [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref>{{Twitter|PhilSzostak|status/1325853597414772736|[[Phil Szostak]]|quote=Initially sketched in February 1979 for #TheEmpireStrikesBack, Ralph McQuarrie completed his "bog planet tree creature" painting in 1993 for The Illustrated #StarWars Universe, later inspiring both the krykna for #StarWarsRebels and the spiders for Chapter 10 of #TheMandalorian.}}</ref> In the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] continuity, the artwork of the knobby white spider inspired three other creatures:<ref>{{Twitter|PhilSzostak|status/1324640601602576384|[[Phil Szostak]]|quote=@Aviriia They are new! Both inspired by the same design.}} {{C|In response to "Can you confirm if the creatures were Krykna or that it are completely new creatures inspired by the ralph mcquarrie art?"}}</ref> the [[spice spider]] of [[Taul]],<ref name="Phantom Limb">[[Star Wars Special: C-3PO 1|''Star Wars Special: C-3PO'' 1]]</ref> the [[krykna]], a spider-like creature found on [[Atollon]],<ref name="The Mystery of Chopper Base">{{Rebels|The Mystery of Chopper Base}}</ref> and the [[knobby white ice spider]] of [[Maldo Kreis]].<ref name="Chapter 10">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 10: The Passenger}}</ref>
